name: 93-vertical-overflow
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { border: 1px solid #999; margin: 8px 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; } .ellipsis { writing-mode: vertical-rl; width: 54px; height: 150px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .break-word { writing-mode: vertical-rl; width: 96px; height: 130px; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-overflow: clip; }
html:
竖排省略号：这段文字很长，应在列尾显示省略号。
SUPERCALIFRAGILISTIC 超长西文词应按列长断行。
